Off-Shoulder Zip Knit & Cargo Pants
Rights check
Source: 25068.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight dark hair
parted to one side stands against a white backdrop.
She wears a white ribbed knit off-shoulder cardigan
with a wide folded neckline and a double zip down the
front, with a chain-link ear cuff and a silver necklace. A
low-rise beige cargo trouser sits beneath a white logo
waistband. Her expression is calm and direct, with
glossy red lips. Soft, even studio light. Palette of ivory,
sand, and silver. Sleek and minimal, in the style of a
minimalist knitwear campaign.
Sleek, minimal, structured
WORKING NOTES
- The off-shoulder zip and cargo trousers are the defining
silhouette.
- Keep the white backdrop for a clean catalog feel.
